promotion_gate: The AXIAL instrument is ACTIVE for ordinary orientation/re-entry. Its comparative usability and physical-embodiment claims remain unresolved under the existing evolution.evidence_gate; failure of those claims does not invalidate the working orientation utility.
research_question: Does a persistent navigable overview plus explicit engineering witness reduce orientation loss during deep focus while preserving the directness of the primary ring surface?
known_gap: The overview and inspector are implemented but unmeasured. Their usefulness must be judged from ordinary navigation, especially re-entry after interruption, BACK usage, wrong-ring manipulation and whether users consult the overview without it becoming clutter.

current_classification.basis: 0.7.2 transfers exact overview and witness mechanisms from recovered donors, keeps study local and non-self-modifying, and introduces no proof-state promotion.
